# Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow root `AGENTS.md` before planning, editing, reviewing or running
experiments. It is the canonical cross-agent workflow for all subsequent phases;
consult its referenced contract files rather than duplicating their policies.

Critical reminders: map changes to panel requirements and existing acceptance
scenarios; never weaken frozen eval to hide failures; keep evaluation answers out
of production context; derive urgency in code; distinguish actual system evidence
from evaluator self-tests; preserve source bytes and never commit secrets.

Use `README.md` for repository navigation and verified commands. Apply the
controlled-change and review process in `AGENTS.md` when evaluation changes are
genuinely necessary. These instructions guide agent behavior; they do not enforce
acceptance or certify a result.
